phrases.text: Could we have the bill, please?

translations.ar: هل يمكننا الحصول على الفاتورة من فضلك؟
translations.pt: Poderíamos ter a conta, por favor?
translations.fr: Pourrions-nous avoir l'addition, s'il vous plaît ?
translations.de: Könnten wir bitte die Rechnung haben?
translations.it: Potremmo avere il conto, per favore?
translations.en: Could we have the bill, please?

phrases.text: Do you accept credit cards here?

translations.pt: Vocês aceitam cartões de crédito aqui?
translations.fr: Acceptez-vous les cartes de crédit ici ?
translations.en: Do you accept credit cards here?

phrases.text: I would like to order now.

translations.pt: Eu gostaria de fazer o pedido agora.
translations.en: I would like to order now.

phrases.text: Where can I find mineral water?

translations.ar: أين يمكنني أن أجد مياه معدنية؟
translations.fr: Où puis-je trouver de l'eau minérale ?
translations.en: Where can I find mineral water?

phrases.text: Is there a discount on this?

translations.fr: Y a-t-il une réduction sur cela ?
translations.en: Is there a discount on this?

phrases.text: This jacket is too expensive for me.

translations.es: Esta chaqueta es demasiado cara para mí.
translations.ar: هذه السترة باهظة الثمن بالنسبة لي.
translations.pt: Esta jaqueta é muito cara para mim.
translations.fr: Cette veste est trop chère pour moi.
translations.de: Diese Jacke ist mir zu teuer.
translations.it: Questa giacca è troppo costosa per me.
translations.en: This jacket is too expensive for me.

phrases.text: I am just looking around, thanks.

translations.de: Ich schaue mich nur um, danke.
translations.en: I am just looking around, thanks.
